product: AltContext customer account portal (APP-1) — standalone React/Vite SPA at apps/app-portal
goals: PROPOSED inventory for account UI before screen code: visible sign-in, sign-up, signed-in user chrome, and sign-out. Clerk hosted or @clerk/react prebuilt components own the credential forms; this app does not invent a password field (NAV-08, NAV-12, CARD-06).

Disabled/unavailable configuration is a designed screen, not a blank shell: missing VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, portal flag off, or Clerk session load failure each have copy and no primary auth action (RLSE-04, CARD-03, FORM-09).

No fake tenant claims: Clerk user id/email is identity only. Tenant UUID, admission, and API keys remain existing backend authority. Never render Clerk OrganizationSwitcher or a guessed tenant name (DOM-03, CARD-12, HAI-05).
Never put CLERK_SECRET_KEY in the browser. Publishable key only. Wrap Clerk behind the SPA auth chrome so the rest of the product can swap identity later (REF-15, CARD-16).
Logout is a first-class exit back to signed-out chrome. Signed-in-but-not-admitted is a distinct error, not a tenant dashboard (NAV-07, CARD-15).

jobs.label: Sign in or sign up with Clerk and return to the account origin
See the signed-in Clerk user and sign out
Understand when the portal cannot run and what to do next

screens.title: Account › Signed out
screens.purpose: PROPOSED job entry. Clerk session loaded and signed-out. Two plain-language doors (NAV-08): Sign in (primary) and Create account. No tenant name, no key list, no billing. first_time is first visit with no in-tab Clerk session residue. loading is ClerkProvider still resolving; open-sign-in and open-sign-up stay disabled until the provider is ready. In default and first_time, both doors are enabled. Serves authenticate-session.

zones.label: PROPOSED AltContext account heading and one-sentence purpose. Does not name a tenant.

PROPOSED signed-out chrome: Sign in (primary) and Create account. Both doors are enabled in default and first_time after Clerk is ready, and disabled while the provider is loading. Implement with @clerk/react SignInButton / SignUpButton or equivalent signed-out rendering. No custom password form.
PROPOSED polite status: loading session; ready to sign in. Icon plus token color, not color alone.

screens.title: Account › Sign in
screens.purpose: PROPOSED account sign-in surface opened from signed-out chrome. Prefer @clerk/react <SignIn /> on /sign-in or SignInButton hosted Account Portal. Credential fields, MFA, and recovery are Clerk-owned. Escape returns to portal-signed-out (NAV-07). error is provider failure, not a tenant error. Serves authenticate-session.

zones.label: PROPOSED secure account sign-in surface. App chrome may frame it; app does not collect passwords.
PROPOSED Back to account / no active session. Link to Create account. Does not claim a tenant.

screens.title: Account › Create account
screens.purpose: PROPOSED account setup surface. @clerk/react <SignUp /> on /sign-up or SignUpButton hosted Account Portal. Creating a Clerk user is not tenant admission and must not say an AltContext workspace is ready (DOM-03). Serves authenticate-session.

zones.label: PROPOSED secure account setup surface. Account setup remains separate from backend access admission.
PROPOSED Back to account. Link to Sign in.

screens.title: Account › Signed in
screens.purpose: PROPOSED signed-in chrome after Clerk session exists. UserButton shows the signed-in person and Sign out is visible. open-user-menu is available in signed-in default/loading chrome; sign-out remains the session exit. Tenant/key/billing regions stay empty or 'Waiting for account' until backend /portal/me succeeds; never invent a tenant label from Clerk org or email local-part (DOM-03, CARD-12). loading is the Clerk plus backend identity check. error with backend 403 not_admitted routes to portal-not-admitted, not this screen's success grid. Serves manage-session.

zones.label: PROPOSED signed-in chrome: @clerk/react UserButton (profile) and visible Sign out. Show when signed-in. open-user-menu is available while identity is loading or ready; no OrganizationSwitcher.
PROPOSED identity strip: signed-in person presentation name/email from useUser. Tenant UUID only if backend returned it. Empty = signed in, tenant unknown — not a fake workspace name.
PROPOSED status: session ready; checking account; account access not linked yet. Icon plus token color.

screens.title: Account › Unavailable
screens.purpose: PROPOSED designed unavailable. Missing or empty publishable key, or server portal flag off, is not a crash blank (RLSE-04). Sign in / Sign up / User / Sign out are absent or disabled (FORM-09). Copy distinguishes configuration missing (error) from portal closed (degraded). No Clerk widget. Serves recover-unavailable.

zones.label: PROPOSED substitute status. error: This account page is not configured. degraded: Account access is turned off. Contact support. No Sign in control.

screens.title: Account › Not admitted
screens.purpose: PROPOSED signed-in Clerk user whose backend identity link is missing, unverified, or ineligible. UserButton and Sign out remain so the person can leave (NAV-07). Do not show keys, tenant UUID, or an invented workspace. Backend reason codes stay non-enumerating (tenant_not_eligible / email_unverified / claim_missing as generic account-not-ready copy). Serves recover-unavailable.

zones.label: PROPOSED: Account access is not ready yet. Sign out stays available. No tenant or key claims.
PROPOSED UserButton + Sign out still visible so the session can be ended.

screens.title: Account › Sign-in unavailable
screens.purpose: PROPOSED provider/session endpoint failure after a publishable key exists. Bounded wait then this error (INT-08, RES-13). Retry reloads the SPA. Do not fall back to a homemade login. Existing WordPress API keys are not this screen's concern and must not be described as broken here. Serves recover-unavailable.

zones.label: PROPOSED: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again. Icon plus token color. No tenant claims.

screens.title: Sign out
screens.purpose: PROPOSED session signOut then return to portal-signed-out. Clears the sign-in session on this origin. Does not revoke tenant API keys (backend authority). Serves manage-session.

zones.label: PROPOSED: Session ended. Browser returns to signed-out chrome. Existing API keys are unchanged.

open_questions: Embedded <SignIn/> / <SignUp/> on SPA routes vs hosted Account Portal via SignInButton: S1 pins the supported @clerk/react pattern when provider setup is ready. Either way, visible Sign in / Create account / User / Sign out stay in app chrome.

How the SPA learns portal-disabled vs missing-key vs sign-in outage without reading secret env files in the client: publishable key absence is client-detectable; portal flag must come from a non-secret public config or build-time define, never CLERK_SECRET_KEY.
Invitation-only admission copy vs open signup: Plan 0001 uses hashed invitations. This map does not invent an invite field on the account widget; admission remains backend.
not_doing: Do not scaffold Clerk over the monorepo root or the WordPress plugin. SPA lives only in apps/app-portal.
Do not use Next.js Clerk APIs (@clerk/nextjs, auth(), clerkMiddleware). Package is @clerk/react.
Do not put CLERK_SECRET_KEY, webhook secrets, or login material in the SPA, commits, or this map.
Do not render OrganizationSwitcher, fake tenant names, or treat Clerk email as tenant UUID (DOM-03).
Do not mint, rotate, or display API keys on these account screens; keys stay existing backend authority.
Do not add invitation/claim, usage, or billing journeys here. B1 later extends this SSOT after those contracts exist.
Do not claim OBSERVED-UI: apps/app-portal does not exist until browser code is implemented.
Do not replace local API-key recognition when sign-in is down; this SPA failure is portal-only (CARD-16, REF-15).

Do not run CLI init, accountless setup, login, provisioning, or credential-file access for this offline slice. Use manual @clerk/react integration with offline mocks; do not hardcode a rescued app ID as proof of the production application.
